narr: A stalled boundary along the LA coast in association with a stationary low in the northeast Gulf created multiple rounds of heavy rain. This caused some isolated flash flooding along the I-12 corridor in Baton Rouge and St. Tammany Parish.
ev: Spotter report of flooding in the Village St. George area.
